api_key.description: Unscoped organization API key. A scoped key is refused by the account-management API.

deployment.description: Which Atlassian this company runs: cloud or data_center. The form opens on cloud; a value written here also decides a Jira or Confluence url whose host is not Atlassian's own.

api_key.description: ${VAR} holding an API key, read under auth.mode api-key. Empty reads the CLI's own key variable.

credential_bundle.description: ${VAR} holding a bundle exported by crewlet llm export.

deleted_retention_days.description: How long a repository removed from code.repos stays restorable by declaring it again under its name, before it is purged and its name is free: 1..365 days; unset (or 0) is 7.

native.description: Host the company's git repositories in the engine itself, on its own state log: every data node commits their pushes. A node running no native backend yet starts the code host at the activation that sets it; on a node whose native runtime already runs, turning it on or off takes effect at the node's restart, which the node says (native_backend_needs_restart).

repos.description: The company's repositories, at most 10000. Each activation creates the ones declared and settles their settings; removing one deletes it, restorable for deleted_retention_days by declaring it again.

max_blob_bytes.description: The largest file (blob) a push may carry, at most max_push_bytes; unset is 50 MiB. A larger binary belongs in tracker files.

max_push_bytes.description: The largest pack one push may send; unset is 1 GiB, the most it may be.

pushes_per_seat_day.description: How many pushes one seat may land in one day on the company's calendar, every repository together: 1..100000; unset is 1000. A runaway bound on what a seat pushing in a loop costs the code log, not a budget; a person's pushes are never counted.

repo_max_bytes.description: The most packed bytes one repository may hold, at least max_push_bytes; unset is 20 GiB. Every git node serving a repository caches it whole.

seat.description: A seat, by its handle. Exactly one of unit and seat.

unit.description: A unit of the chart: its id, or its name where it has none. Exactly one of unit and seat.

paths.description: The paths it owns: 1 to 32 globs over the repository's tree, each relative to its root, at most 128 bytes. A component of * matches one component and * within one any run of characters but /; ** matches whole components (zero or more, one or more as the last), so docs/** is everything inside docs and **/*.go every Go file; a glob holding a * has at most eight components, and a glob with no * matches only that path. ?, [, \ and a leading ! are refused: * is the one metacharacter. Each glob once.

seat.description: A seat, by its handle. Exactly one of unit and seat.

unit.description: A unit of the chart: its id, or its name where it has none — its effective lead is whom a review is asked of. Exactly one of unit and seat.

allow_delete.description: Let a push delete a matching ref.

allow_force.description: Let a push move a matching branch to a commit that does not descend from it. Not on a tag rule: a tag never moves.

branch.description: A branch name or glob: * matches one path component, ** any number, and a name with no * matches only itself. Exactly one of branch and tag.

direct_push.description: Who may push to a matching ref directly: persons (unset), a person and never a seat, whose push is refused; or none, which freezes it — nothing pushes to it.

tag.description: A tag name or glob, as for branch. Exactly one of branch and tag.

archived.description: Read-only: still fetched and cloned, and takes no push.

default_branch.description: The branch a clone checks out; unset is main.

name.description: The repository's name: one label of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or a digit, at most 63 — no dot, which only a seat's own scratch repository's name carries. It is the address a repository is cloned by, so renaming one here deletes it and creates another.

path_owners.description: Who owns which of the repository's paths, at most 64 owners: a change touching an owner's paths asks it for a review. A path owner is asked, never granted: it reads and pushes what the chart lets it, as before.

protect.description: The rules a push to the refs they match is held to, at most 64. A ref no rule matches may be force-pushed or deleted by anybody who may push.

visibility.description: Who may read it besides persons: company (unset) — every seat — or unit — the owning unit's members, its leads and the owning seat.

idle_days.description: How many days a seat's scratch repository may go with no push, rename, settings change or restore before it is deleted — restorable for deleted_retention_days, like any deleted repository. A repository a live turn has named is never deleted while the turn lasts. 1..365; unset is 7.

max_per_seat.description: How many scratch repositories one seat may hold, every one it owns short of purged — a deleted one counts until its purge frees its room. 0 lets no seat create one; 0..1000; unset is 50.

agents_manage_others.description: Let an agent publish over, update and reshare artifacts it does not own. Off by default.

seen_by.description: Who sees who has opened an artifact: editors (the default) or nobody.

cloud_id.description: Atlassian Cloud id. Give this or url, not both.

email.description: Set for Cloud Basic auth; omit for bearer-token auth.

site_url.description: Human-readable base for shareable links; needed with cloud_id.

token.description: Admin API token or PAT; ${VAR} supported.

url.description: Instance URL. Give this or cloud_id, not both.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC secret for Data Center webhooks.

webhook_token.description: Shared token for Confluence Cloud webhooks, carried in the registered URL; minted by crewlet confluence provision.

enabled.description: Record and replay per-conversation history (default on).

retention_days.description: How long a conversation is remembered.

handle_tag.description: Monitor tag key naming the seat an alert wakes (default crewlet).

provisioning.description: Inputs for provisioning agent identities at Datadog.

route_to.description: Handle of the seat an alert naming no owner wakes; required when enabled.

webhook_name.description: Name of the webhook the engine keeps at Datadog; monitors name it as @webhook-<name> (default crewlet).

webhook_token.description: Shared token compared against X-Crewlet-Token; required when enabled.

api_key.description: Datadog API key; says which organization.

app_key.description: Datadog application key; says which user acts.

email_domain.description: Domain agent service-account addresses are built under.

role.description: Role each agent's service account holds (default Datadog Read Only Role).

budget_fraction.description: Share of the parent's remaining budget one delegate call may spend.

call_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap on a whole delegate call, waves included.

max_parallel.description: Workers running at once within one delegate call.

max_tasks_per_call.description: Tasks one delegate call may contain.

max_turns.description: Tool rounds one worker may run.

max_turns_ceiling.description: Highest max_turns a worker template may declare.

min_tokens_per_task.description: Floor on one worker's token share; below it the call is refused.

api_key.description: Remote sandbox API key; required. ${VAR} supported.

domain.description: Self-hosted sandbox cluster domain; empty = vendor cloud.

template.description: Box template. This is where vCPU/RAM/disk are set: at template build time.

base_url.description: Endpoint for an openai-compatible embedding service.

dimensions.description: Vector width; 0 takes the named model's own width. 64..4096 to override, and it must match what the model produces.

max_batch_inputs.description: Most inputs one request may carry; 0 takes the named model's documented limit. Required where none is documented; may only lower a documented one.

max_batch_tokens.description: Most tokens one request may carry, summed over its inputs; 0 takes the named model's documented limit. Required where none is documented; may only lower a documented one.

max_input_tokens.description: Most tokens one input may hold; 0 takes the named model's documented window. Required for a model this build does not know; may only lower a documented one.

compacted_max_age_days.description: Age at which compacted summaries are dropped; 0 = never.

compaction_batch_size.description: Raw episodes pulled into one pass.

compaction_jaccard_threshold.description: Similarity that pools two episodes into one cluster.

compaction_min_age_days.description: Only compact rows older than this.

consolidated_grace_days.description: Audit grace before a consolidated raw row is dropped.

exemplar_count.description: Originals kept raw after a cluster is compacted.

max_raw_episodes_per_agent.description: Raw episodes per seat that trigger a lifecycle pass.

non_terminal_max_age_days.description: Age at which mid-state episodes are dropped.

tool_free_max_age_days.description: Age at which raw turns that called no tools are dropped.

provisioning.description: Inputs the reconcile loop and the provisioning CLI both read.

token.description: Organization token with admin:org_hook, for one organization-wide hook. Empty means each agent's own app carries its own.

url.description: Enterprise Server base URL, e.g. https://github.example.com. Empty = github.com.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC secret for inbound deliveries; required when enabled.

org_webhook.description: auto (one org hook where the credential may), true, or false.

provisioning.description: Inputs the reconcile loop and the provisioning CLI both read.

signing_secret.description: Standard-Webhooks signing token; required when enabled.

token.description: Read PAT for participants-based routing; empty degrades routing.

webhook_name.description: Name every hook the engine registers on this instance carries; give two deployments watching one instance two names (default crewlet).

admin_token.description: Personal access token with the full api scope, belonging to a group owner. Creates and removes the service accounts.

group.description: Top-level group the service accounts join.

group_webhook.description: auto (one group hook if the plan allows), true, or false.

mode.description: Where service accounts are owned: group (default, and all GitLab.com offers) or instance (self-managed only; needs an instance-administrator token).

projects.description: Extra projects to join and hook.

token_scopes.description: Scopes minted on each service-account token.

retention_days.description: How long a person's inbox keeps a notice (default 365, 30..3650). The history it points at is untouched.

atlassian.description: Atlassian organization and its unscoped API key, used to create one service account per agent. Absent = accounts are made by hand.

check_interval_seconds.description: How often a converged integration is read back, in seconds. 0 takes the default of 600; the floor is 60.

confluence.description: Confluence instance or Cloud site, org read account and webhook secret. Absent = disabled.

datadog.description: Datadog monitor alerts delivered as inbound events. Absent = disabled.

forge_app_id.description: Forge app id, verified against a relayed Cloud event's invocation token. Required for Jira or Confluence Cloud.

github.description: GitHub.com or Enterprise Server, webhook secret and provisioning. Absent = disabled.

gitlab.description: GitLab instance, webhook signing and provisioning. Absent = disabled.

jira.description: Jira instance or Cloud site, org read account and webhook secret. Absent = disabled.

mattermost.description: Mattermost instance and team. Absent = disabled.

slack.description: Slack working-indicator settings. Each seat carries its own app under role.integrations.slack. Absent = disabled.

cloud_id.description: Atlassian Cloud id. Give this or url, not both.

email.description: Set for Cloud Basic auth; omit for bearer-token auth.

site_url.description: Human-readable base for shareable links; needed with cloud_id.

token.description: Admin API token or PAT; ${VAR} supported.

url.description: Instance URL. Give this or cloud_id, not both.

webhook_name.description: Name the engine's own Jira webhook is registered under; give two deployments watching one instance two names (default crewlet).

backend.description: Which knowledge base: native, confluence, or none. Empty derives from integrations.confluence.

root_space.description: Container for org-level pages such as the root Onboarding. Absent takes the default.

skills_container.description: Container holding tool-skill pages. Absent takes the default; "" turns tool skills off.

vectors.description: Fuse semantic recall into knowledge and work search; false also stops embedding the corpus. Unset derives from providers.embeddings.

agent.description: Which coding CLI to drive (default claude-code).

env.description: Extra environment for the CLI child process.

max_concurrent.description: Concurrent CLI processes; each costs 200-400 MB.

mode.description: text (a model behind the engine's tool loop) or agent (the CLI runs the executor).

model.description: Model id, in the CLI's own grammar (OpenCode: <provider>/<model>).

overrides.description: Field-wise overrides of the built-in CLI profile.

run_in.description: Where an agent-mode run happens. Empty = providers.sandbox.default_run_in.

state_dir.description: Credential + per-seat home directory, each CLI under <state_dir>/<agent>. Entries sharing one and a CLI share a login.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap on one CLI invocation (default 600).

enabled.description: Master switch for agent learning (default on).

image.description: Container image with the coding-agent CLI installed. Required for run_in: container.

network.description: Container network; setting it to none also cuts off the coding agent's LLM.

run_args.description: Extra container run arguments. This is where a local box is sized.

runtime_env.description: Environment for the container runtime's own CLI (not the box); ${VAR} supported.

state_dir.description: Parent directory for box directories; used by both local placements.

headers.description: Headers sent with each request (http); ${VAR} supported.

name.description: Server name; the key seats declare credentials under.

optional_keys.description: Keys of env, headers or a seat's mcp_env block for this server whose value may resolve to nothing; such a key is left out rather than holding the server back.

shared.description: One shared instance (default), or false for one per seat.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: Bounds connect and handshake, and separately the first tool listing. 0 is the engine's default.

tool_annotations.description: Per-tool behavioural-hint overrides, keyed by bare tool name.

tool_prefix.description: Prefix applied to this server's tool names.

provisioning.description: Inputs the reconcile loop and the provisioning CLI both read.

team.description: Team slug the agent bots belong to.

typing_status.description: When to show the typing indicator (default always); it costs a request every few seconds per thinking seat.

admin_token.description: System-admin token used to create and to disable the bots.

display_name_suffix.description: Suffix on each bot display name, e.g. " (AI)".

username_prefix.description: Prefix on each bot username, e.g. agent-.

max_refreshes_per_turn.description: Distinct memory refreshes one turn may make.

embeddings.description: Embedding provider for semantic knowledge search and for diary and episode recall.

llm.description: Named models, each a coding CLI the engine drives; seats select one by key.

llm_order.description: Provider precedence; normally derived from the order they are written in.

sandbox.description: Code sandbox backend. Absent = no seat runs code.

enabled.description: Run reflection after each turn (default on).

persist_decider.description: Run the persist decision after each turn (default on).

summarize_episodes.description: Summarise the turn-start Similar prior work block's hits into one briefing through the auxiliary model (default on); query_episodes is never summarised.

availability.description: Human seats: free-text availability shown in rosters.

avatar.description: Agent seats: the Crewlet character and colour the seat is drawn as. Absent = the original Crewlet, in purple.

backstory.description: Who this seat is; reaches its prompt.

behavioral_guidelines.description: How this seat should work; reaches its prompt.

code.description: This seat's access to the company's code, on the native code host and on GitHub.

contact.description: Human seats: external account ids per surface.

email.description: Seat email; plus-addressing derives from the handle.

goal.description: What this seat is for; reaches its prompt.

handle.description: Canonical slug, and how lead and manages name this seat. Immutable: it derives the seat's durable id, so changing it removes the seat and creates another.

health_tools.description: Agent seats: offer this seat fleet_health and code_status, the administrator's reads of the deployment's health, and wake it each time an alarm fires or clears on a node. Setting or clearing it takes admin.

learning_enabled.description: Override company learning for this seat.

llm.description: Provider key, chain, or per-phase mapping.

llm_auxiliary.description: Cheap model for reflection and summaries.

llm_judge.description: Cheap model for the round-cap extension judge.

llm_sandbox.description: Model the sandboxed coding agent runs on.

manages.description: Seat handles or unit keys this seat manages; a unit key expands to its seats.

mcp_env.description: Per-seat MCP credentials: env vars (stdio) or headers (http).

name.description: Seat name, shown to people; also the source of the auto-derived handle. Nothing references a seat by it.

placement.description: Which nodes may run this seat. Absent = any node that runs seats.

project.description: Tracker project this seat owns. Root-level seats; a unit member takes its unit's.

sandbox.description: Per-seat code sandbox gate. Absent = never offered.

schedules.description: Recurring work fired into this seat's inbox.

space.description: Knowledge container this seat owns. Root-level seats; a unit member takes its unit's.

token_budget.description: This seat's own token ceilings per calendar window on the company clock: day, week and month, each optional. Absent = only the company's ceilings apply.

unit.description: Key (id) of the home unit for a root-level seat; the seat is moved into it.

workers.description: Delegate templates this seat may use; empty = every one.

character.description: The Crewlet character this agent seat is drawn as. Absent = crewlet, the original.

color.description: The colour this agent seat is drawn in. Absent = purple.

access.description: read_only, review or full_access. Empty means read_only.

app_id.description: Numeric id of this seat's GitHub App. Written by the engine.

app_slug.description: Slug of this seat's GitHub App; the bot login derives from it.

installation_id.description: Installation of this seat's app on the organization. Written by the engine.

private_key.description: Reference to this seat's sealed GitHub App key. Returned by GitHub once.

repos.description: Repositories this seat works in, as owner/name. Empty means all the installation covers.

webhook_secret.description: Reference to this seat's sealed GitHub App webhook secret. Returned by GitHub once.

github.description: This seat's own GitHub App: the repositories it works in, and the identity the engine records for it. How much it may do is the seat's code.access.

mattermost.description: This seat's Mattermost bot: one token covers everything.

slack.description: This seat's own Slack app: bot token and signing secret.

bot_token.description: Bot personal access token; one credential covers everything.

channel.description: Channel this seat's bot is added to at provisioning, on top of provisioning.channels.

username.description: Bot username, or one whole ${VAR} naming it; defaults to the seat handle.

labels.description: Node labels that must all match.

node.description: Exact node id to pin this seat to.

coding_agent.description: Override the provider default for this seat.

enabled.description: Offer this seat the sandbox tool.

env.description: Env for this seat's sandbox run; declare external tokens here.

max_turns.description: Agentic-round cap for this seat's coding runs. Unset = provider default; 0 = uncapped.

optional_keys.description: Keys of env whose value may resolve to nothing; such a key is left out of the run rather than refusing it.

pause_ttl_seconds.description: Paused-box TTL. Unset = provider default; 0 = never pause.

run_in.description: Where this seat's code work runs; self = inside its own agent-mode executor run. Empty inherits providers.sandbox.default_run_in.

setup.description: Per-seat provisioning steps, applied after the engine-wide ones.

servers.description: MCP server names the coding agent may use.

bot_token.description: Bot token for outbound Web API calls.

signing_secret.description: Verifies inbound webhooks for this seat's app.

default_coding_agent.description: Coding agent for seats that name none.

default_max_turns.description: Agentic-round cap for coding runs on seats that name none. 0 = uncapped.

default_pause_ttl_seconds.description: Paused-box TTL before reap and re-seed. Unset = 1800s; 0 = never pause.

default_run_in.description: Where a box whose placer names no cell runs: a sandbox-enabled seat whose executor is not in agent mode and names no run_in, or an agent-mode providers.llm entry with no run_in. Required unless the catalogue names exactly one cell, or every such seat and entry names its own.

default_timeout_seconds.description: Box TTL/keepalive. Not a run cap: the orphan-reclaim grace.

e2b.description: The remote backend. Absent = run_in: e2b is refused.

fake.description: Use the in-process double for every placement. Demonstrations only.

local.description: The engine host as a backend. Absent = run_in: direct|container is refused.

setup.description: Provisioning steps applied to every box before per-seat extras.

brief.description: What this step made true about the box, told to the coding agent.

commands.description: Shell commands run in order; a non-zero exit fails the box.

env.description: Env merged into the run; resolved once at launch, not at load.

files.description: Files written into the box before commands run; a body that is exactly one ${VAR} is that variable's value.

name.description: Short identifier used in logs and failure messages.

optional_keys.description: Keys of env, or paths of files, whose value may resolve to nothing; left out rather than refusing the run.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-command wall-clock cap for this step.

catchup_max_seconds.description: Upper clamp on the missed-tick catchup window.

catchup_min_seconds.description: Lower clamp on the missed-tick catchup window.

enabled.description: Master switch for the scheduler (default on).

jitter_seconds.description: Deterministic per-schedule jitter to spread a popular minute.

tick_seconds.description: Scheduler poll interval; under 60s catches every cron minute.

archive_after_days.description: Unused days before a skill is archived.

interval_hours.description: How often the curator walks the skill table.

stale_after_days.description: Unused days before a skill goes stale.

enabled.description: Promote sibling skills to unit scope (default on).

jaccard_threshold.description: Similarity that pools two seats' skills.

min_sibling_count.description: Distinct seats a cluster needs before promotion.

auto_refine_on_failure.description: Append a counter-example when it failed (default on).

auto_refine_on_success.description: Append an observation when a skill's turn succeeded (default on).

max_body_chars.description: Ceiling on a refined skill's body.

cluster_jaccard_threshold.description: Similarity that pools two turns into one cluster.

cluster_min_size.description: Turns a cluster needs before it earns a skill.

cluster_window_hours.description: How far back the clustering pass looks.

duplicate_jaccard_threshold.description: Reject a draft this similar to an existing skill.

episode_fetch_limit.description: Episodes pulled into one clustering pass.

min_tool_calls.description: Tool calls a turn needs before an inline draft.

scheduler_interval_seconds.description: How often the clustering pass runs.

typing_status.description: When to show the working indicator (default always).

default.description: Lines for any phase with no pool of its own.

execute.description: Lines shown while the agent works.

onboarding.description: Lines shown during the first-turn onboarding pass.

review.description: Lines shown while the reviewer judges the work.

day.description: Most tokens one day may spend, local midnight to midnight on the company clock. Absent = no daily ceiling; 0 is refused.

month.description: Most tokens one calendar month (on the company clock) may spend. Absent = no monthly ceiling; 0 is refused.

week.description: Most tokens one ISO week (from Monday, on the company clock) may spend. Absent = no weekly ceiling; 0 is refused.

backend.description: Which work tracker: native, jira, or none. Empty derives from integrations.jira.

delegation_depth_limit.description: Maximum depth of agent-to-agent delegation chains.

execute_max_tool_rounds_ceiling.description: Hard ceiling for executor rounds across extensions.

extension_round_step.description: Maximum rounds one extension call may grant.

max_tool_rounds.description: Tool rounds within one executor run.

onboarding_max_tool_rounds.description: Rounds for the first-turn onboarding pass; 0 disables it.

onboarding_max_tool_rounds_ceiling.description: Hard ceiling for onboarding rounds across extensions.

sandbox_min_budget_tokens.description: Refuse a coding run below this remaining budget.

channel.description: Unit channel on the company's chat surface; inherited by child units.

goals.description: What this unit is working toward.

id.description: Stable identity for this unit, and how lead, manages and unit references key it. Minted from the name at import when unset. Lowercase, starts with a letter.

knowledge.description: Free-text knowledge references. Not a read scope.

lead.description: Handle of the seat leading this unit; inherited from the parent when empty.

mcp_env.description: Credentials inherited by this unit's direct agent members.

name.description: Unit name, shown to people. Nothing references a unit by it.

project.description: Tracker project this unit owns. Not a credential, not a read scope.

schedules.description: Recurring work owned by this unit.

space.description: Knowledge container this unit owns. Not a credential, not a read scope.

description.description: What this worker is for, written for the executor choosing one.

max_turns.description: Tool rounds this worker may run; 0 takes the runtime cap.

model.description: providers.llm key for this worker; empty takes the seat's llm_subagent chain.

output.description: JSON Schema for this worker's structured answer. Absent takes the default shape.

system_prompt.description: The worker's persona and standing instructions. The runtime preamble is appended.

tools.description: Tools this worker asks for. Still filtered against the caller's own tools at spawn.

mcp_servers.description: Tool servers, stdio or http. Per-agent credentials live in role.mcp_env.

mission.description: One line on what the company is for; reaches every seat's prompt.

name.description: Company name. Half of every seat's derived id: effectively permanent.

notification_coalesce_max_batch.description: Events drained into one batch before partitioning by conversation, 1..100. Bounds a digest too, since a digest cannot exceed a drain.

notification_coalesce_window_seconds.description: Inbox linger before dispatch, 0..60s. 0 adds no latency.

notification_rate_limit.description: Inbound notifications one seat may be woken by per second; 0 (default) = unlimited.

policies.description: Company-wide rules injected into every seat's prompt.

skill_variables.description: name -> value facts substituted into tool-skill text. Keys must be identifiers.

timezone.description: The company's one clock, an IANA zone (default UTC): where its days and weeks begin, what a relative or all-day date resolves to, and what a schedule naming no zone fires on.

token_budget.description: Org-wide token ceilings across all seats, per calendar window on the company clock: day, week and month, each optional. Absent = uncapped.

units.description: The org hierarchy; units nest to any depth.

vision.description: Longer statement of where the company is going.

workers.description: Reusable delegate templates, keyed by the name an executor calls them by.
